0.body: plan was just marked filterable. The registry says so — but no slot has been reserved for it yet, so a filter naming it is refused before the database is even touched.

1.body: The Watcher was stopped, so nothing was provisioning capacity. Starting it lets the next tick provision a page, reserve a slot, and write the first 500 of 600 contacts into it.

2.body: Two more ticks drain the last 100 contacts and flip the slot from backfilling to ready.

3.body: Same filter, same field, no code change on your side — it now reads a real index.

evolve.done: That is the whole backfill window: intent recorded immediately, capability arriving once the daemons catch up.
